answer.summary: The Docker build fails in Maven dependency resolution for openaev-es8-client: co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java:8.19.25 cannot be found in Central, shibboleth-releases, or jboss-public. The PR bumps elasticsearch.version, so the new version is the likely cause. A retry would probably fail the same way unless the artifact was simply not yet mirrored, so check that 8.19.25 is published and the version is correct.

evidence.quote: #30 16.13 [ERROR] Failed to execute goal on project openaev-es8-client: Could not resolve dependencies for project io.openaev:openaev-es8-client:jar:3.261110.0
#30 16.13 [ERROR] Could not find artifact co.elastic.clients:elasticsearch-java:jar:8.19.25 in central (https://repo.maven.apache.org/maven2)
